vb_textbox.text: Hi! I am sorry for the detailed and lengthy advice, but it contains important information that I assure you is worth understanding. There are two important features to understand in this game.The first important feature is that gnomes will appear in fixed pairs: orange & brown, green & pink, red & yellow, blue & purple. Their positions will change but will always  be in these set pairs. The second is that each gnome will lead you to a different forest: either a bright forest with red basket or a dark forest with yellow basket. Specifically, orange, green, red and blue gnomes will guide you to the bright forest, whilst the others will take you to the dark forest. Your goal is to consistently reach the forest that contains the most mushrooms. Be aware that the number of mushrooms in each forest will constantly change and that the mushrooms will go through cycles of lows and highs. The bright forest will consistently contain more mushrooms but will drop to low numbers. If the bright forest consistently gives low numbers, go to the dark forest. Best of luck!
